column3: BootUI 2.4.0 #1600: missing driver metadata (name, version, URL), failed ORM model discovery, or cut/failed PostgreSQL relation inventory emit WARNING diagnostics and leave report status PARTIAL with incomplete coverage; absent ORM models are neutral INFO skip; complete empty inventory does not make datasource partial

SQLAlchemy Inspector get_table_names() natively includes PostgreSQL partitioned tables (relkind in 'r', 'p') in a single query; sharpit has no separate getTableTypes() catalog query and does not fall back from partitioned tables to plain tables
Hibernate metadata diagnostic source adapted to SQLAlchemy metadata in Python (neutral INFO on absent models, WARNING on discovery error)
